items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And here come Chris Kelly. ... And Chris Kelly is playing for them

ctx.x: Chris, Lordy." See? And you heard that. And you'd see Kid Rena, and you'd see a battle of music -- Kid Rena and Kid Ricotti(?), cousins, but that don't make no difference, 'cause the blood's gonna fly if they meet today. And they're both advertised in the same neighborhood. And here come Chris Kelly. And here come Long-Haired Bob with his truck or on his wagon. And them cats meet on the corner, and they're battlin' to draw a crowd of about four or five hundred people. They stand there and they blow. And they were…

And then they have a party in the Pecan Grove, and you go in there and you get on a fence and look down at... Pecan Grove is a yard that had a large pecan tree in it, and the people from the lower coast, the people that work hard... And they was all dark people, you see, because in New Orleans you get them different color strata, you see. But these were all dark people, and they all look alike, and they're all dancing, and they're having fun. And Chris Kelly is playing for them, and he'd playing them low-down…
